Title: Meridian Loan Origination: SERVICE_TASK kyc-aml-check inside PARALLEL_GATEWAY fork never dispatched; instance stalls ACTIVE (UAT WF05-FULL3-20261001 F1). Severity MAJOR. Symptom: meridian Loan Origination v1.1 on QA: after credit-memo-review (ben) and risk-assessment (miriam) complete, current_nodes=[kyc-aml-check]; instance ACTIVE >6.5min (past 300s timeout_ms) with no task, no SERVICE_TASK_COMPLETED event, no EXECUTION_ERROR, no DLQ row; endpoint answers 200 directly; top-level service tasks complete in 2-6s. Suspect SERVICE_TASK activation inside PARALLEL_GATEWAY fork branch (cf. ISS-0398 walk_to_gateway, resolved): likely no service_task_dispatches row armed on the fork/join walk path (Letflow.Engine fork activation / arm_service_task_dispatch call sites / TaskActivation). ALSO: kyc-routing has no unconditional edge and the stub endpoint returns no kyc_status, so the token may stall at kyc-routing even once dispatched -- assess whether fixture/process-definition issue (test/fixtures/qa/ meridian loan origination definition); handle or file separately. Acceptance: SERVICE_TASK nodes on a PARALLEL_GATEWAY branch are dispatched and recorded; meridian loan-origination scenarios reach committee/L1 routing and complete; regression test fail-first reproducing the stall at engine level. Evidence: test/uat-reports/uat-2026-10-01-WF05-FULL3-20261001-NARRATIVE.yaml (on PR #2129 branch origin/pr2129 only). Q-926 (body_template rendering) is DONE and merged on main -- build on it.

task.description: WF-03 Step 2 fix design for ISS-0928/Q-928. Read the step-01 diagnosis (handoffs/WF03-Q928-20261001/step-01-issue-fixer-diagnose.json result.summary). Produce design artefact under lib/letflow/design/ (design only, no implementation code): (1) engine.ex persist_service_task_advance error arms -> record ExecutionError no_matching_gateway_edge exactly as the human-task completion path (dispatch_task_completion_hop_chain) does, with the transaction semantics decided explicitly (dispatch row must not stay 'advanced' with token parked and no record; state precisely what is persisted and committed); (2) service_task_dispatcher.ex L614 no silent swallow (log + audit); (3) check timer re-entry path (~L2949) for same shape; (4) fixture: default edge kyc-routing -> assessment-join in test/fixtures/qa/meridian_loan_origination_process_definition.json with version bump (and mirror in test/fixtures/simulation/meridian/ if a copy exists), scenario/test impact; (5) fail-first test plan incl. fork-branch and top-level; (6) tenant isolation/security notes. Edit only the design file(s) and your handoff; fill result and set COMPLETED with real completed_at.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers each of the six items

result.summary: Design written to lib/letflow/design/WF03-ISS0928-fix-design.md covering all six items. Decisions: (1) persist_service_task_advance/10 unwraps both no_matching_edge shapes into ExecutionError.append_multi (locked_projection reuse) inside the single outer advance_after_service_task_outcome transaction, which COMMITS: EXECUTION_ERROR event + dlq row + projection :error; no SERVICE_TASK_COMPLETED, tokens/variables unchanged, dispatch row stays 'advanced' (never reverted: at-most-once HTTP); returns {:ok,:error_set}; shared error_args builder extracted. (2) dispatcher L614 arm: Logger.error + best-effort independent audit service_task.advance_failed with atom reason tag only (no payload). (3) timer path checked: bounded by fire_error_count retries -> ExecutionError+DLQ, no change. (4) fixture: add unconditioned is_default edge e9-default kyc-routing->assessment-join, version 1.1->1.2, seed script header comment; no simulation/meridian loan copy exists; scenarios need no edit. (5) tests T1-T8, fail-first, top-level and fork-branch. (6) tenant/security notes; SECURITY-REVIEWER marked REQUIRED. Open questions OQ-1..4 listed with defaults. Nothing was run (design only).
issues: OQ-3: residual re-entry failures (hop limit, unknown token, merge rejection) are only logged/audited, instance stays ACTIVE; recommend follow-up issue.
OQ-4: absent kyc_status -> pass-through is a QA business assumption to confirm with BA-MERIDIAN.
